**Risk flags:**
- Defendant in 1 case(s), total claims RM126,600  
- Single shareholder holds 84.31%

**Overview:**  
Murni Bestari Tech Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company incorporated on 19 July 2015, operating in Labuan’s technology sector. It provides cloud hosting and managed IT services. The firm has a share capital of RM5,000,000, two directors, and a dominant shareholder owning 84.31% of the equity. Financial snapshots show revenues of RM14,565,245; RM15,038,620; and RM15,810,227 with equity rising from RM9,391,951 to RM11,392,085. The company has been involved in two legal cases, acting as defendant in one.
